title: Ocean floor relief
quote: Canyons and trenches = slope; volcanoes and earthquakes = deeps; most extensive = deep sea plain

boxes.title: Oceans at a glance
items: ==**Pacific > Atlantic > Indian > Southern > Arctic**== (Arctic smallest, APPSC GS 2018)
**Bathymetry**: mapping sea floor; **fathom** = depth unit (**6 feet**)

levels.name: Continental shelf
levels.note: to ~**200 m**; fishing, oil; "submerged prolongation of land"

boxes.title: India's shelf
items: ==Wide off west coast== (Gujarat-Mumbai; **Bombay High**); narrow on east
**40th Amendment (1976)**: shelf minerals vest in Union

boxes.title: Temperature & salinity
items: Layers: warm surface → **thermocline** → cold deep (0-4 deg C)
Salinity ~**35 ppt**; raised by evaporation, lowered by rain/rivers
Highest in subtropics; Black Sea **17-18 ppt**; Baltic lowest

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: APPSC G2 2023: slope = canyons & trenches; deeps = volcanoes & earthquakes
APPSC G1 2024 trap: "coarseness increases seaward" WRONG
**Deep Ocean Mission** (**2021**, **Rs 4,077 crore**): MATSYA-6000, **Varaha** at **5,270 m**
